prerequisites: Thermal-technical, geometric and operating characteristic of heating surfaces. Option and dimensioning of heating surfaces with respect to heating system and calefactory.

learning_outcomes.text: Acquire needed knowledge and skills for engineering practice in the area of heating surfaces.

syllabus_topics: Heat transfer in defined space and at heating surfaces.
Design solutions, materials and usability of individual heating surfaces.
Options and dimensioning of heating surfaces.
New methods of heating surfaces design - optimization.
